title: fix(plugin-detail): a collapsible section prints a plain heading on a print page (objectui#12732)
body:
Fixes #12732
Clause-②: no

## What

On a page that declares `print`, a collapsible `record:details` section now prints its header as a plain heading. In `DetailSection`, the non-collapsible condition becomes "not collapsible, or on a print page". It reuses the `isPrintPage` value that objectui#12717 already reads once above every early return. The printed header keeps the section title, icon, header colour (`headerColorClass`), `showBorder` and description, and the content is always shown. The disclosure button, `aria-expanded`, the chevron and the `cursor-pointer` / hover classes no longer print. Off a print page the collapsible branch is unchanged.

## Tests

- New `detailSectionPrintHeaderChrome-12732.test.tsx`: inside a `PrintPageProvider` there is no button, no `aria-expanded`, no lucide chevron and no clickable-header classes, and the icon, header colour, description and values are present. CONTROL outside it: the button with `aria-expanded`, the chevron, the hover and cursor classes, and click-to-toggle are unchanged.
- `detailSectionPrintPage-11958.test.tsx`: the print row used to assert the disclosure button's `aria-expanded="true"` on paper, which is the defect this card removes. It now asserts that no `aria-expanded` is present and keeps the values-shown assertion.
- Pin-first on the unfixed tree: the print row failed and the control passed.
- Ablation with the fix committed (`if (!section.collapsible || isPrintPage) {` back to `if (!section.collapsible) {`): `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`. Both print rows went red and both controls stayed green. The file was restored from HEAD and its blob hash matches HEAD.
- Earlier package run (`pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail`): 2664 passed and 1 failed, the new row's own async-icon timing. That row was fixed and re-run green; the full package run was not repeated on the final head, so CI's run is the reading.
- Final head 1f9baa0: the six plugin-detail print and header test files, 29 passed.
- The 19 test files in app-shell, plugin-form, fields and console that name `DetailSection`: 501 passed.

## Printed page

A console harness page, not the showcase invoice (no backend was booted): two collapsible sections, one authored collapsed, printed to an A4 PDF with Chromium.
- Before, under print: 2 chevrons, 2 header buttons with `aria-expanded`.
- After, under print: 0 chevrons, 0 `aria-expanded`; the title, icon, header colour, description and values all print.
- Off print: identical before and after.

The PNGs are on branch `claude/issue-12732-evidence` under `evidence/12732/`.

## Acceptance notes

- On a print page `className` now lands on the Card rather than the outer Collapsible wrapper. No caller passes it.
- A collapsible section with no title prints no header, which is the plain branch's existing rule.
- The hover copy buttons still mount on paper at `opacity-0` and draw nothing. This is outside this card.
